text_en: To the leader: according to The Dove on Far-off Terebinths. Of David. A Miktam, when the Philistines seized him in Gath.
text_cn: 达味金诗，交与乐官。作于培肋舍特人在加特捉住他时。调寄"远方无声鸽"。

text_en: Be gracious to me, O God, for people trample on me; all day long foes oppress me;
text_cn: 天主，求你怜悯我，因为人要谋害我， 时时处处有人攻击我，有人欺压我。

text_en: my enemies trample on me all day long, for many fight against me. O Most High,
text_cn: 我的仇敌终日谋害我， 攻击我的人实在众多。

text_en: when I am afraid, I put my trust in you.
text_cn: 至高者！恐惶侵袭我的时日， 我只有全心仰赖你。

text_en: In God, whose word I praise, in God I trust; I am not afraid; what can flesh do to me?
text_cn: 我全心倚赖天主，并歌颂他的许诺： 我决不怕血肉的人，对我要做什么。

text_en: All day long they seek to injure my cause; all their thoughts are against me for evil.
text_cn: 他们终日破坏我的生活， 千方百计地想加害于我；

text_en: They stir up strife, they lurk, they watch my steps. As they hoped to have my life,
text_cn: 他们群集埋伏，窥伺我的行径， 他们等待时机，谋图我的性命。

text_en: so repay them for their crime; in wrath cast down the peoples, O God!
text_cn: 天主，求你审判他们的罪行； 求你在盛怒中将异民敉（mǐ）平。

text_en: You have kept count of my tossings; put my tears in your bottle. Are they not in your record?
text_cn: 我多次流离失所，你都知悉， 我的眼泪，聚在你皮囊里； 岂不是也写在你的书卷内？

text_en: Then my enemies will retreat in the day when I call. This I know, that God is for me.
text_cn: 我几时呼号你，我的仇敌便退却， 从此我也全知道，天主常扶助我。

text_en: In God, whose word I praise, in the Lord , whose word I praise,
text_cn: 我全心倚赖天主，歌颂他的许诺；

text_en: in God I trust; I am not afraid. What can a mere mortal do to me?
text_cn: 决不怕脆弱的人，对我要做什么。

text_en: My vows to you I must perform, O God; I will render thank offerings to you.
text_cn: 天主，我必遵守向你所许的愿， 我必要向你偿还颂谢的祭献。

text_en: For you have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from falling, so that I may walk before God in the light of life.
text_cn: 因为你救我脱离死亡，使我的脚免于跌仆， 使我能在活人的光明中，在天主面前行走。
